Native SDL key events still carry Unicode zero. Complete committed strings and IME composition reach focused Controls separately under ADR 0038; per-key Unicode attribution needs a native source that identifies the producing key without guessing from later SDL text events.

The pinned method calls a focused editor-specific _set_text path, or its embedded subwindow equivalent. Native committed-text delivery does not provide that programmatic editor replacement contract; it requires a typed text-control owner and embedded subwindow focus routing.
